idea-plugin.name: Technical Debt Accountant
idea-plugin.description:
Technical Debt Accountant

Speak management's language. Technical Debt Accountant transforms abstract code quality issues into dollar amounts — with ROI calculations, interest rate tracking, and burndown charts that make the business case for refactoring impossible to ignore.

Key Features

  • Debt Inventory — Catalog tech debt items with categories, priority, and estimated cost
  • Dollar Valuation — Assign monetary value to each debt item based on team cost rates
  • Interest Rate Tracking — Model how debt compounds over time if not addressed
  • ROI Calculator — Calculate return on investment for fixing specific debt items
  • Hotspot Detection — Identify code areas with the highest debt concentration
  • Git Integration — Link debt items to commits and track age via blame

Why Technical Debt Accountant?

Engineering teams struggle to get refactoring prioritized because debt is invisible to stakeholders. This plugin makes tech debt tangible — with the same financial language used to justify every other business investment.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Debt inventory (up to 50 items), time tracking, hotspot detection, Git integration
  • Pro ($8/month): Unlimited items, dollar valuation, interest rate modeling, ROI calculator, burndown charts, management reports (Markdown/PDF), and team dashboards
